description: This PHP class defines a model for representing a weekly work schedule indexed by days of the week, used within the OrangeHRM leave plugin module. It implements the Normalizable interface, utilizes traits for serialization, and maps a WorkWeek entity to a structured data format for API responses.

classes.name: WorkWeekIndexedModel
classes.description: A model class that serializes a WorkWeek entity into an indexed array representing days of the week for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a WorkWeek entity, setting filtering options and attribute mappings for serialization.

parameters.name: $workWeek
parameters.description: The WorkWeek entity to be modeled.
